scope: READ_ONLY_PLAN; no production/SDK/config changes; no hardware or target build
confirmed_gap: ESP_GATTS_CONF_EVT currently only processes an active confirmPending waiter. Callback status with no waiter is uncounted. Thus fe=0 and synchronous API ESP_OK cannot exclude a later local SDK rejection.

proposed_minimum.eventOk: Count every CONF event with status ESP_GATT_OK, regardless of active waiter.
proposed_minimum.eventError: Count every CONF event with status other than ESP_GATT_OK, regardless of active waiter.
proposed_minimum.eventUnmatched: Count every CONF event that cannot match a current pending confirmation waiter. This is an overlapping count, not a third mutually exclusive status.
proposed_minimum.existing_semantics: Preserve current generation/connId/handle matching, confirmation wake, staleConfirmation counter, and protocol framing. Update aggregate counters under the existing short stats lock; no per-notification printing.
proposed_minimum.attribution: Unmatched must not be labelled FAST, stale, peer ACK or a particular connection epoch. The callback lacks a unique transmit/connection-generation token and connId may be reused.
proposed_minimum.meaning: These are local SDK callback observations. Successful FAST notification callbacks do not prove central reception, application reception, or complete scientific-frame reconstruction.
test_plan: success and error with no waiter
mismatched conn/handle stays unmatched and preserves stale semantics
event counters wrap according to uint32 protocol contract
no callback payload retention or allocation

sdk_candidate_constraint: Do not edit the external ESP-IDF tree. Any future successful-CONF payload-copy optimization requires measured CPU/event evidence plus a separately authorized project-contained reproducible patch guarded by exact SDK source hashes.
pipeline_freeze: tools/test_ble_pipeline.py + tests/host/test_ble_pipeline.c + tests/host/ble_pipeline_stubs/common.h; 20 executed cases, 18 finite semantic-invariant cases and 2 explicit NOT_PROVABLY_BOUNDED outcomes. No performance/HIL acceptance; older TX8 failure remains unchanged.
